_comment: FR-137: core-owned Layer-1 surface declaration. Declares the global skills surface (canonical skills root + the non-Claude harness targets that project it). Distinct from a project's per-project harness-manifest.json (which carries agents[]). The compiler reads BOTH this file and the merged agent manifest, unioning their surface declarations: this file owns core skills; the merged agent manifest (incl. the FR-139 personal overlay) contributes project + personal skills. MIRRORED under core/scripts/ (TD-096). os_context is reserved for FR-140 and intentionally omitted here.
